svg.aria-label: Invoice retrieval: sources, ERP receiving and customer actions
svg.title: Invoice retrieval: sources, ERP receiving and customer actions
svg.desc: Four stages: receive and save invoices, view invoice list, select and open invoice, and choose the next action. Use existing platform connections and current permission. Public and private sources can both apply; save each file when it arrives. Original checks and ERP delivery continue separately from permitted saved-file access. If the original is not saved, resolve its retrieval from an available, permitted source and repeat the source checks. If retrieval cannot complete, show the next action and owner. ERP delivery stays pending while safe copy access can continue. The list includes sent and received invoices and distinguishes an empty list, incomplete collection and a failed request. Opening does not download or accept the invoice. Download, review and leaving a decision pending are separate choices. Buyer actions when only a copy is available remain an open decision in SPEC026. E markers refer to a shared problem or pending result. Colours group activities; they do not indicate implementation or readiness.

g.text: Invoice retrieval: sources, ERP receiving and customer actions
Four stages. Files are collected automatically; customers can view permitted saved files while ERP delivery continues.
Colours group activities. They do not show whether a function is ready or built.
Use the selected business’s connected platforms.
Check current receiving, viewing and download permission.
Process each file when it arrives.
Keep one invoice if delivery repeats.
If blocked, show next action and owner.
Saving a file is separate from ERP receipt.
ERP receipt is separate from buyer acceptance.
Safe copy viewing and download can continue.
Open one invoice. Show its details,
Return the file or a clear
Users can open the list while collection is pending.
Opening does not download the file
Download is optional and is not required before review.
Buyer actions when only a copy is available: decision open (SPEC026 §3.4).
Show the reason, next action and who must act.
Keep successful results. Retry only the affected step.
If the result is unknown, check what happened before trying again.
All E markers use the same exception result.
Stage 1 is inbound only. The list also includes sent invoices. Customer access does not wait for ERP delivery.
Solid: process steps and handoffs. Dashed: saved-file availability, conditional choices or exception references. Stage numbers are not delivery phases. Detailed rules: SPEC026.
